text:
Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, to be performed on an 
 (l/4) annually bases as indicated by M3 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Sherif Kamal Issy, tested by eng. Mohamed 
 Hussein Sherif, accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed Kamel Afify and 
 approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour Power Station 
 and MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes ...etc.
Stop the unit
Isolate the air fan mechanically & 
 electrically
Open the drain valves for (all 
 boiler parts)
Tools 
and Equipment
Work shop kit (spanners & wrenches)
Screw drivers & gear pullers 
 .... 
 etc
General purpose grease
Power supply panel
Spanner & wrenches
Amyant
Welding equipment
Work to be 
carried out
Operate to check the performance
Define the troubles
Disassemble the defective units
Remove 
 the insulation
Check external body and piping 
 joint
Check the upper & lower air gates 
 (inner quill)
Check the flanges, setting, 
 pivots & glands
Check for any corrosion in the duct 
 body
Check the external isolating cover
Assemble the element & closed the 
 doors
Check the condition (open & close)
Adjust
Check after repairing
Restore all valves to the operation normal position
Clean the area after repairing
